en: Just kiddin'. It's a joke.
Wh-what the?!
Is somebody there
note: No end punctuation: shared #265 x3 + #537 add '...?'.

en: Damn it, a thief!
Prepare yourself!!
Whoa, the drink's got my f-feet all
wobbly...
You'd best cut back on the drink for now.
Waaaaaaaaaaah!!
A drunkard... I hope he proves useful.
note: No speaker label; read as the player's remark after enthralling Dudley. Japanese has no parentheses, so none added.

en: I'm Dudley, I run the inn.
Free of work and the missus,
I'm off to the pub for a pint right now.
Feelin' light on my feet!
I'm off for my usual pint
at the pub.
You hear all sorts of rumors there.
It's a fun place!
Why don't you come along to the pub
with me now?
I'm Dudley, the innkeeper.
I just had a pint at the pub.
I'm Dudley, I keep tellin' ya!
Ahh, I'm good and drunk.
, say,
were you a twin all along?
What, no?
There's two of you walkin' side by side!
Huh, my mistake.
note: Msg 140541 joins #3642 (...Hic.) after a pause; variant without the period gives 'Huh, my mistake...Hic.' (slice 045 note agrees).

en: Nah, can't be. You're still young.
Besides, with a fine fella like you, women'd
meekly do whatever you tell 'em.
Jack, eh...
Business is good, it seems.
were you a twin all along?
No, wait, looks like you're triplets, eh?
note: No used_in in slice; msg.py places it in msg 141101 after #3709.

en: I shall obey your orders...
Forgive me, my guest, but I cannot
entertain you today...
My only daughter, Rose, has been laid low
by illness...
Ah... I fear for my daughter.
Forgive me, my guest, but your business
must wait for another day.
Her illness seems to be some kind of anemia,
yet there is nothing wrong with her blood,
nor anything else wrong with her body...
Our family doctor can only shake his head.
Tell me, do you know of a good doctor?
I meant to arrange a match for my daughter
soon, but that is now quite
out of the question.
The patent agent I had in mind for her,
young Jonathan Harker, has lately
returned to London, it seems, but...
Pardon me. Who is this Jonathan...?
Ah, the son of a businessman I know.
He was away in Eastern Europe on business,
note: Followed by #2214 variant 'or so I hear.'

en: All I wish for now is my daughter's recovery.
I can think of nothing else.
My wife was frail, and died of illness when
our daughter was still small...
So that my daughter would never be lonely,
I poured all my love into raising her
all these years, and yet...
If my daughter were to go before me too, I
don't know what I would do...
Forgive me, but my daughter's health
is only getting worse...
I must ask you to leave for today.
The truth is, my only daughter, Rose, has
fallen quite ill, you see.
Forgive me, my guest, but I must ask you to
leave for today.
Would you visit her now and then?
Yes, gladly, if I can be of any help.
Excuse me, but who is Jonathan...?
our daughter was still small, you see...
all these years...
